verdicts.reason: A is a proper left-to-right leaderboard: the can stays inside its circle at the left, then wordmark, headline and body, the badges stacked as a group, and a dominant CTA at the right. Its flaws are small: the body copy is small and the badge column sits a bit loosely in the middle. B breaks apart the can and its circle: the empty circle sits at the far left and the can is stranded at the right. It also puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline and shrinks the CTA to badge size so it gets lost in the pill row. The body copy is too tiny to read, and there is dead space on both sides.
